text_block_list.text:
One holiday. Kawakami Princess was making 
a guest appearance at a new TV show's 
reveal event.

text_block_list.name: Female Moderator
text_block_list.text:
Today, Kawakami Princess-san has rushed 
over to show her support for the new 
PreFie release~!

text_block_list.name: Female Moderator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess-san, you entered the 
racing world because you looked up to 
PriFigh, right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed I do. I wish to perform 
brilliantly, elegantly, and courageously, 
just like PreFie♪

text_block_list.name: Female Moderator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, Kawakami Princess-san, 
what is your everyday life usually like?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In the morning, like a proper 
princess, I never skip my morning tea.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"And on nights when I'm tired from 
practice, I make sure to take a rose bath 
to relax♪"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even PriFai says, "A true princess must 
hone herself daily!"

Showing no signs of nervousness, Kawakami 
Princess confidently handled the talk 
event. And then, at that moment—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... isn't something wrong with that 
truck?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: No... Look out—?!

A commotion could be heard coming from the 
street. Looking over, a large truck was 
swerving erratically toward the sidewalk!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You must not!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Out of my way! I can catch up, I know I 
can!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hnghooooo~~t!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy!! Rise and shine, sleepyhead!! 
Kindly get your butt out of bed right now, 
please and thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Pardon me for interrupting your 
conversation♪
(Silence...)

text_block_list.name: Female Moderator
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible, Kawakami Princess-san...! 
That was tremendous acceleration...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much! This is the 
fruit of living like a proper princess♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, morning tea... using a 
giant steel teacup for muscle training! At 
night, 300 squats before a rose bath!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess is forged through 
training! Mighty legs are the mark of a 
princess! That's what PreFigh taught me!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
It's the real deal... a real-life 
PreFighter is right here...!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Big sis is so cool--!!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing!! What else!? What kind of 
training do you do!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Female Moderator
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone! Please calm down!! Don't push 
the person in front of you...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gyawa!? Everyone's so riled up— I feel 
like things are getting out of hand here, 
you know???!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What should we do, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Calm down, how about trying to soothe them 
like a proper princess?
We can solve this with princess power too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I see! Stay calm... act like a 
princess...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone~? Could you please mind your 
manners a bit more—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Jeez!! I said quiet down! Please! Listen! 
To! What! I! Have! To! Say!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOH!!!)

It took quite a while for the venue's 
excitement to die down. From that day 
forward, Kawakami Princess's fans grew 
even more passionate than ever!

text_block_list.name: Female Moderator
text_block_list.text:
B-But what do you mean, "solve it with 
princess power"...? How do we even do 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Even PreFie said, 'A princess 
must have fighting spirit!'...

With that said, Kawakami Princess stands 
tall with her hands on her hips in front 
of the grand piano set up beside the stage 
for the concert.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (TA-DAAAAAANNN!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
E-very-oneee!!! Please quiet down a 
little! You are causing a scene for the 
people around us!

Perhaps startled by the fierce power 
behind Kawakami Princess's shout, the 
commotion came to an immediate halt!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mind your manners when looking upon a 
princess! That's a promise between me and 
PriFighter!

Thanks to this stern rebuke, the rest of 
the event proceeded smoothly.
